# waroom_on_call_trigger (Data Source)

Retrieves information about a Waroom on-call trigger, the condition under which an incident calls escalation policies.

Look up a trigger either by `uuid` or by `name`. When looking up by `name`, set `service_name` too if triggers in different services share the same name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a trigger by UUID.
data "waroom_on_call_trigger" "by_uuid" {
  uuid = "770e8400-e29b-41d4-a716-446655440001"
}

# Look up a trigger by name within a service.
data "waroom_on_call_trigger" "critical" {
  service_name = "example-service"
  name         = "critical incidents"
}

output "critical_trigger_escalation_policy_uuids" {
  value = data.waroom_on_call_trigger.critical.escalation_policies[*].uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the trigger to look up. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.
- `service_name` (String) The name of the service the trigger belongs to. When set together with `name`, the lookup is limited to this service. Cannot be set together with `uuid`.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the trigger to look up. Exactly one of `uuid` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the trigger is enabled.
- `escalation_policies` (Attributes List) The escalation policies the trigger calls. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--escalation_policies))
- `event_type` (String) The event that fires the trigger. Currently only `incident_created`.
- `id` (String) The ID of the trigger. This is an alias for `uuid`.
- `retry_count` (Number) How many times the escalation restarts from the beginning when no one responds.
- `severity_filters` (List of String) The incident severities the trigger applies to (`critical`, `high`, `low`, `info`, `unknown`).
- `source_filters` (List of String) The incident sources the trigger applies to (`integration`, `slack`, `web`).

<a id="nestedatt--escalation_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `escalation_policies`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The name of the escalation policy.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the escalation policy.
